result.rationale: The diff adds `totalPages: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. With 100 users and limit 50, this yields 3 pages while only 2 exist; currentPage = floor(offset/limit)+1 = 2 when offset=50, so showingLast (currentPage == totalPages) is false, allowing 'next' to fetch offset=100 (empty members page). The correct formula uses Math.ceil. This is a verifiable off-by-one introduced by the new pagination code.

Looking at line 13: `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` - for 100 users with limit 50, this calculates Math.floor(100/50) + 1 = 2 + 1 = 3 pages, when there should only be 2 pages. The correct formula should use Math.ceil(user_count / limit) or handle the exact boundary case differently. This is a real off-by-one bug that would cause an empty extra page to appear when user_count is exactly divisible by limit.
